svg.title: P8 legacy pages as panels: Keyboard, Keyboard lights and Keyboard art in the Hub (drawn mockup, not an egui render)
svg.text: P8 · Legacy pages as panels (proposed) · drawn mockup with the hub's theme tokens
Module mode only. With module mode off (the default) none of this exists: no page, no tiles; Foxglove keeps its own tray and window.
Hub-drawn frame states (5, 6, 7, 9) are the supervisor's existing words; the module draws only the body and its one button.
Hub window, module mode on, Foxglove connected: one page, three summaries, one button each.
Your keyboard, its lights and its art, as the Foxglove app sees them.
